currentFieldPassages.summary: HLA-C often has lower surface expression than HLA-A/B, while allele and cell context affect the comparison.

objections.defect: notes[0] says the lower-expression statement is "not supported by the abstracts read and is not asserted here", while notes[2] and the summary assert it. The packet claims selected full-text reads of Kaur and Schellens; in those texts the locus-level statement is background citing earlier work (Kaur introduction; Schellens results discussion), not a finding of either study, and the Kaur abstract states only allele-specific variation.

proposedReplacement.notes[0]: Abstract-depth reads on 9 November 2026, with selected full-text reads of Kaur et al. (2017) and Schellens et al. (2015). The abstracts do not state that HLA-C is expressed below HLA-A and HLA-B. That statement appears as background, citing earlier work, in the Kaur introduction and in the Schellens results; it is reported here as background and not as a result of either study.
proposedReplacement.summary sentence: Kaur et al. (2017) showed that HLA-C surface expression varies across individuals in an allele-specific manner, influenced by the structure of the peptide-binding cleft and peptide diversity; the introduction of that paper, citing earlier work, describes HLA-C as expressed at lower surface levels than HLA-A and HLA-B, and allele and cell context affect any such comparison.

objections.creditEffect: R38 not credited until corrected. The assignment caveat itself (HLA-C assigned only when a peptide could not be assigned to HLA-A or -B; authors expect to underestimate) is verified and correct.

In panel 2 the dashed lines join the Fc gamma receptor to the C1q bar and the C1q bar to a cell, not each partner to the Fc; a reader may take the dashes as receptor-binds-C1q. Panel 1 and 3 are clear. Not a scientific defect in the lesson text.
The germinal-centre panel contains an unlabelled outlined polygon inside the GC ellipse.
In panel 2 the "Same TCR" label is crossed by the arrow and the X and Y glyphs sit under the peptide curve; readable but cramped.
Labels are small at the figure width; worth a phone-width check.
The field names ERAP trimming as part of step 3; the figure shows Cut, Transport, Load, Display, Recognition without a trimming step. Consistent as a five-step schematic; not an error.

Both source SVGs define colours as CSS custom properties on :root inside an SVG style element; a direct librsvg render is solid black (viewed). A browser resolves them. newTeachingRequirement.requirement: Breast and melanoma studies associate organised immune responses with outcomes, retaining each study's specimens, methods and setting.
newTeachingRequirement.exactExcerpt: In untreated invasive breast-tumour specimens, Gu-Trantien and colleagues linked CXCL13-producing follicular helper T cells in TLS germinal centres and an eight-gene signature to group outcomes, including survival or preoperative chemotherapy response. In metastatic melanoma samples, Cabrita and colleagues associated co-occurring CD8-positive T cells and CD20-positive B cells with survival, and a derived TLS signature predicted outcomes in checkpoint-blockade cohorts. Each result retains its specimens, methods and setting; these associations do not establish that inducing a TLS will benefit a particular patient.

coordinatorResolution.r38ExactExcerpt: Apps and colleagues found lower HLA-C than HLA-A/B in the analysed healthy-donor peripheral blood lymphocytes with the A*02:01/B*44:02/C*05:01 haplotype; the magnitude differed between flow cytometry and mass spectrometry. This is a defined comparison, not a universal hierarchy.
